cohort: existing AC3 Astra MAX 120 model answers, 30 related synthetic histories
reference: two user-confirmed independent human checks of AI-assisted reviews; prior observations mean this is not a held-out comparison
model_scorers: same source-derived taxonomy rubric and structured output, question + answer + confirmed memories; no expected answer, human label, or dimension
scoring: failure recall = correctly identified human-reference failures / all 69 agreed failures; false-positive numerator and all 51 human-pass denominator reported; abstentions and transport errors counted as not detected and separately reported
call_policy: one attempt per answer, no outcome-based retries; no invented results; raw outputs preserved
caveats: model endpoints and structured output implementation differ
rule baseline is deterministic and uses its archived inputs and implementation
existing answers were produced by Astra MAX
previous reference reviews used AI assistance
reuse of cases means not prospective held-out evidence
